verification.image_identity_method: Exact listed bytes/hash were checked independently and decoded before visual inspection. IDs in this report are zero-based resource indices in the pinned manifest because the manifest itself has no explicit ID field.
verification.visual_method: Actual exact PNG pixels were placed as labeled before-left/candidate-right pairs, preserving aspect and full frame; JPEG quality 96 diagnostic derivatives only. Sources were displayed in labeled composites, with only the explicitly scoped July head crop. Original asset bytes were not changed. No JPEG derivative establishes byte-level pixel equality or a calibrated photometric result.

first_whole_findings.tier: confirmed visible comparison plus source-based aesthetic judgment
first_whole_findings.gain: The broad front crown changes from warm pale bronze/cream to cooler gray steel. Under both held lights it integrates better with the dark bill and steel head, while a narrow bronze perimeter remains. The gain is visible at whole scale but local and modest.
first_whole_findings.cost: The crown still catches a broad bright highlight and remains smooth and blank. Some fine streak/variation visible in the previous cap is reduced; a local uniformity cost remains. No important whole silhouette, stance, optic readability, body or foot regression is conspicuous in these whole pairs.
first_whole_findings.source_gap: This is not the fitted swept segmented dark crown and enclosed orbital/cheek construction of the locked full-bird canon and July head identity. Tonal improvement does not close the open brow slot or reconstruct source-shaped plates.

concrete_evidence.finding: Cooler common crown gives a modest whole source resemblance gain
concrete_evidence.tier: confirmed pixel observation / reviewer aesthetic inference
concrete_evidence.detail: Front and front three-quarter pictures make the reduced warm cap strongest. Steel integration is improved; source materials and source cameras are not calibrated to these renders.

concrete_evidence.finding: Improvement does not make the cap dark or segmented in every view
concrete_evidence.detail: Head detail, opposite profile and hero retain broad pale highlights on a smooth roof. The candidate is cooler in color, not a complete elimination of cap brightness or roof dominance.

concrete_evidence.finding: Brow and cheek voids remain dominant inherited source gaps
concrete_evidence.detail: A conspicuous open slot under the roof above the bill root, and sparse isolated curved cheek returns, remain. The sources read as recessed yet formed interlocking surfaces with narrow supraoptic accent and integrated compound hook root; the local finish does not change this enclosure.

concrete_evidence.finding: Rear continuity remains incomplete but is not a new Loop03 cost
concrete_evidence.detail: Large dark under-shell/head rear openings and hollow shoulder/back transitions are visible in both before and candidate. The final change does not visibly repair them, but no conspicuous new seam, projecting strip or loss of rear enclosure is introduced by this local crown appearance in the supplied stills.

concrete_evidence.finding: No fresh body or feet gain should be credited to this loop
concrete_evidence.tier: confirmed local paired image comparison; technical identity unknown
concrete_evidence.detail: The regional body and foot pictures show no conspicuous changed shape or finish at this review scale. The inherited body remains comparatively soft and regular in its broad rounded feather relief, with less dense mechanical layering than source. Feet remain bulky segmented caps compared with finer source articulation and sharp toe/claw relationships. Image-only evidence does not establish payload or material identity.

concrete_evidence.finding: All three era looks remain insufficiently differentiated from their specific source finishes
concrete_evidence.tier: reviewer source-based inference grounded in actual pixels
concrete_evidence.detail: The common gray crown improves coherence but does not supply the distinct pristine/polished, worn mechanical and advanced character finishes. Builder orange optics remain visually stronger; Maker and Mechanic optics remain readable as dark circular enclosures but do not alone establish each source era.

concrete_evidence.finding: Fine crown surface variation trades away some richness
concrete_evidence.tier: visible local comparison, minor aesthetic cost
concrete_evidence.detail: The cool successor face reads more uniformly than the prior streaked warm face. This is a small local cost, not a demonstrated important whole-character loss. High resolution and lighting differences prevent a quantitative realism claim.

continuity_result.finding: Crown tone remains coherent through rotation without the earlier visual01 polygon mosaic. Its effect shrinks on profiles and rear because the front surface is foreshortened or hidden. Original hooked bill and optics remain readable from the supplied opposing sides. No important new angle-specific visual cost was found in this still packet.
continuity_result.caveat: This is bounded actual still inspection, not dynamic browser orbit, physically grounded geometric certification, or proof of material bindings.

verdict.scope: Exact final image-only Loop03 candidate versus exact retained Loop02 pictures: useful local common-crown appearance progress across three eras and both held lights.
verdict.net_gain: Small positive tonal integration without a meaningful new whole or regional cost detected in the supplied image packet; fine variation loss is a minor local cost.
verdict.full_source_likeness: not met in this image review
